data.adaptations: Retain three inline hits and backbone discriminants 0/1. Preserve original normal/small cell physical sizes via explicit typed payload layouts.
Default tblastn word size 3 and neighboring threshold 13 retained; the constructor accepts these fields explicitly.

integration.entry_points: blast_aa_lookup_table_new(word_size, threshold), blast_aa_lookup_index_query(&mut lookup, &matrix, query_codes, included_inclusive_regions, query_bias=0), blast_aa_lookup_finalize(...bone...), blast_choose_protein_scan_subject(&mut lookup), then the stored scan callback.
integration.bone_selection: Original lookup_wrap.c chooses EBoneType::Backbone at query.length >= INT2_MAX*2 (65534); otherwise Smallbone. Normal and small paths are both implemented.
integration.scan_input: AminoAcidSubject { sequence, seq_ranges } uses half-open subject regions. Initial s_range is [0, first.left, first.right-word_length]. Each callback returns ordered offset pairs and updates all three scanning-state fields. For a full subject use one region [0, subject_length].
shared_dependencies: Already translated generic BlastLookupAddWordHit, BlastLookupIndexQueryExactMatches, ComputeTableIndex, ilog2, s_DetermineScanningOffsets and BlastOffsetPair.
LookupTableOptions does not require editing: constructor takes only its word_size and threshold fields explicitly.
ComputeTableIndexIncremental is newly mapped in blast_aascan.rs; parent may relocate it to shared blast_lookup if desired.
integration.scope: Default ordinary amino-acid lookup with BLOSUM62 supplied by existing score block; no PSSM/RPS/compressed lookup or multi-program wrapper port.
